summary: Today’s available signals are mixed-to-bullish for major crypto, with Bitcoin and several altcoins framed as constructive or rotation candidates, while Ethereum still looks relatively weak. The strongest fresh themes are renewed strength in NEAR, TAO, and ONDO, plus a broader altcoin-rotation setup if BTC continues to hold up; however, there is not enough today-specific coverage here to confidently populate all requested stocks, FX, and commodity entries.
